services.name: Governors Balloon Safaris
services.desc: The Grammaticas family pioneered luxury tented safaris in Kenya, when they established Governors’ Camp on the banks of the Mara River as early as 1972. In 1978 they began hot air balloon safaris and for the last 45 years and have flown the same spectacular route down the river and traditions such as toasting your landing back to earth with a glass of sparkling wine, have endured. Over this time, we have maintained an impeccable safety record. From the very early days we have always employed the world's best balloon pilots and our staff have made contributions to the developments of commercial balloons from the small 8 man to the 16 man balloons you see flying today. Al fresco bush breakfast cooked fresh on the plains
blurb: Guests take a hot air balloon flight at dawn from Little Governors’ Camp, drifting along the best balloon flight path in the Mara for 45 minutes to an hour. After landing, guests toast with bubbly and enjoy a fresh al fresco bush breakfast on the plains. Afterwards, a leisurely drive back to camp or lodge is provided.
